data.name: Valentine's Day Harbor Cruise
data.headline: Saturday, February 14 | 2.5 Hour Cruise | 4:30pm
data.description:
#Valentine's Day Harbor Cruise with Triton Charters 

Valentine's Day is here! 💘 Grab your favorite person or group and climb aboard our 75ft Catamaran to enjoy a 2 1/2 hour Valentine's Day charter on San Diego's Harbor! 

This Valentine's Day event takes place at [2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA 92106](https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106097016057293421045)

meeting_point.address: 2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA US 92106

data.what_is_included:
## Individual tickets are $55 per person • Tickets for 2 are $80 • Tickets include:

- Fully Stocked Bar for purchase 🥂
- 4:30-7pm ❤️⛵️
- Option to add-on charcuterie and dessert boxes at check-out! 🍰
- Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your charter time!
data.cancellation_notes: For special or holiday ticketed events, our cancellation policy requires a 72 hour notice. You may receive a full refund if you cancel at least 72 hours before the departure time. No refunds will be issued for cancellations made within 72 hours of the event start time. You have the option to reschedule to a regular ticketed charter but please note we cannot refund the price difference from the special event when rebooking.
data.booking_notes:
Congrats! You are now confirmed for the best Valentines Day adventure that San Diego has to offer! 💘

It's not to late to add our Charcuterie or Dessert Boxes! Give us a call at 844-587-4866 to add to your booking!

**Charcuterie Box for 2 - $35**🧀❤️ 
Brie and artisan cheddar
Freshly sliced prosciutto
Genoa salami
Baguette slices
Bakery sourdough flatbread crackers
Fig jam and sour cherry jam
Plus seasonal fruit (grapes, blackberries, strawberries, raspberries) & additional seasonal accompaniments

**Dessert Box for 2 - $30** 🍓🧁 
Gourmet chocolate bon bons
Chocolate-covered strawberry
Petit fours cake
Mini dessert cup (flavors rotate between chocolate, lemon meringue, tiramisu-style, vanilla, and raspberry).

###Parking Directions:
Please click [HERE](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Shelter+Island+Dr+%26+Anchorage+Ln,+San+Diego,+CA+92106/@32.7205931,-117.2297802,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deaba20dd194af:0x814f40bb62025a8d!8m2!3d32.7205931!4d-117.2275915) for the map of where to park. For free parking, please park in the rear of the parking lot as there are no meters. We do not have assigned parking, so please be sure to come at least 30 minutes early. 

###Walking Directions:
Once parked cross to the other side of the street on Shelter Island Drive and the path to the docks has yellow markers on the corner. The dock path is located between Intrepid Boat Works and San Diego Marine Exchange. Once on the dock path the boat is located at the second black gate. **Check-in will be directly at the gate.** Please fill out your waivers prior to arrival and have your ID handy! 

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/mUsimS2yRfWJd6Kr1RCH)

###Cruise Features
- Splash through San Diego Bay and set your eyes on the greatest monuments that San Diego has to offer including the USS Midway and the Coronado Bridge.
- Your Charter includes a Coast Guard certified captain and crew along with a bartender to serve drinks.
- Triton offers a wide variety of drinks on board including draft beer, wine, mixed drinks and specialty cocktails. Prices range from $8.50 to $14.00.
- Get ready for great music, fresh air, delicious drinks, and gorgeous views! 
- You are welcome to bring some snacks on board to enjoy.

###Please note:
- You must arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes before your scheduled charter time. Check in will be directly at the boat. Please fill out your waivers and be prepared to present your waiver via QR code, and have your ID handy before you arrive! 
- Our charter will not wait for anyone who is late and you will not have the option to rebook if you do not call before the charters departure informing us that you will not be arriving.
- We do not allow any outside beverages on board but you are welcome to bring snacks. 
- For evening charters we recommend wearing a cozy jacket and closed toed shoes to keep warm!
- No animals are allowed on board.
- The Triton is sanitized before, during, and after every charter. Hand sanitizer is available.
- No smoking is allowed on board.
- Triton may change/update/add or remove dates at our discretion.
